issue_summary.SOURCE_CHECK: The paper states "each sample was measured in triplicate in DDA and DIA mode", which refers to the MS acquisition of the samples.
issue_summary.TRUTH_CHECK: The text explicitly mentions "triplicate" measurements for each sample. However, in proteomics, "measured in triplicate" often refers to biological replicates unless specified as technical replicates of the same digest. In this study, the "five different samples" (spike-in states) were each measured three times. These are typically treated as biological replicates in the context of the experimental design (5 states x 3 replicates = 15 runs). There is no mention of additional technical replicates (e.g., splitting one digest into multiple injections) per biological replicate.
issue_summary.COMPLETENESS_CHECK: The value "3" is the only one extracted, but it likely refers to biological replicates, not technical replicates.
